items.title: Local-first Figma alternative in Rust
items.oneliner: Open-source design editor in Rust that stores files locally and replaces subscription design tools for offline workflows.

items.title: Tiny BASIC runs on Arduino
items.oneliner: Lightweight BASIC interpreter lets you edit and run programs directly on Arduino without a desktop IDE.

items.title: Open-source Toit reaches version 2
items.oneliner: IoT scripting language adds stable v2 APIs, broader Arm support, and a rewritten package manager for embedded development.

items.title: Interactive notes for core LLM concepts
items.oneliner: Hands-on notes explain RLHF, attention, LoRA, and evals with concrete examples engineers can study and reuse.

items.title: Dependency-free tactile web components library
items.oneliner: Web Components kit adds soft-body physics, accessible form controls, dark mode, and RTL support without framework dependencies.

items.title: Affordable open-source room-scale gripper robot
items.oneliner: Open robot design costs about $800 and includes build guidance for room-scale manipulation experiments and custom automation.

items.title: Museum collection turned into playable game
items.oneliner: Playable browser game remixes The Met's open collection into a Katamari-style interface worth studying for creative web interactions.

items.title: ByteDance storage paper with useful benchmarks
items.oneliner: Recommender storage paper reports 85.8% lower write latency and 42.1% lower costs, useful for systems design tradeoffs.

items.title: Datacenter Macs for iOS build farms
items.oneliner: Detailed infrastructure walkthrough shows how to rack, cool, and remotely manage MacBooks for large-scale macOS workloads.

items.title: Modern chess engine on 1996 hardware
items.oneliner: Reproducible experiment shows algorithmic gains matter more than custom hardware by running a modern engine on a Pentium Pro.
